purpose: Review-only reference candidates for the code-native hostile laser corridor. These images are not runtime assets.
selection_reason: Candidate B preserves the exact red hostile footprint and dark separation while adding a readable active energy spine and narrow hot core without Candidate A's excessive bloom or Candidate C's split-line ambiguity.

startup: thin near-black perimeter outside the gameplay width
active: thin near-black perimeter outside the gameplay width
forbidden: soft glow, bloom, particles, and raster beam assets

generation.common_prompt: Review-only abstract hostile laser calibration with stacked startup and active swatches. No actors or scenery. The exact collision rectangle remains filled, uses danger red, near-black separation, restrained warm-white live highlight, hard-edged broad planes, square ends, and no endpoint cap, trajectory symbol, soft glow, particles, UI, or text.

variant_prompts.A: Thin hot core with maximum safe-space contrast.
variant_prompts.B: Broad pale-red energy spine around one narrow warm-white core.
variant_prompts.C: Red-dominant inner plane with only a tiny warm-white core.
